column1: # Statically unobserved deps.runtime entries that are nevertheless required.
# Names are versioned recipe `name` values. An upgrade therefore requires the
# exception to be reviewed. The same entry can approve either an unobserved or
# a content-redundant edge when its non-static direct use is documented.
